title: CloddsBot: a self-hosted AI trading agent
friendlyTitle: CloddsBot is an open-source AI trading agent
summary: CloddsBot is an MIT-licensed TypeScript agent for monitoring and trading across prediction markets, centralized exchanges, and decentralized finance venues. The repository has about 1,500 stars and includes strategy, risk-management, data, and execution integrations.
friendlySummary: CloddsBot connects an AI agent to prediction markets, crypto exchanges, and other trading services. It includes tools for finding trades, managing risk, and placing orders.
whyItMatters: Developers can study a broad, actively maintained agent architecture that connects reasoning to real-time market tools and risk controls. Treat it as experimental financial software: review the code, use read-only or simulated modes first, protect credentials, and never assume autonomous trading is profitable or safe.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Developers can learn how a large trading agent is built. Test it without real money first, keep keys safe, and do not expect it to make a profit.
